item.tib: bka' gsang mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud gu ru'i thugs bcud las bla ma zhi ba'i bum sgrub dbang chog
item.coloph: slob dpon thugs kyi sgrab pa 'di/ mkha' 'gro yum chen thugs rje kun sgrol mas/ dus mtha'i kho bo pad ma g.yung drung la/ snyan du brgyud cing rgyas pa'i smon lam btab/ gshen grogs dam ldan rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ shing 'brug lo la dben gnas me ri khrod/ phyi rabs don du dkar chag yi ger bkod//
